---
title: "Posts"
listing:
  contents: "*.qmd"
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  fields: [date, title, description, reading-time]
  categories: true
  feed: true # generates an RSS feed at posts/index.xml
---

PLACEHOLDER — a line introducing this section, or delete it.

If you decide you don't want a blog, remove this folder and the `Posts` entry in the `navbar` block of `_quarto.yml`.
Nothing else depends on it.
